# Code Sigils

> Personal blog on technology, programming, AI tools, books, tutorials, and experimentation. Built with Zensical and hosted on GitHub Pages.

## For AI Agents

When working with this Zensical blog repository, use the [zensical skill](https://github.com/CodeSigils/zensical-skill) to review, edit, and polish articles. The skill handles tone/voice improvements, removal of AI slop, follows site editorial rules, validates links and components, and works correctly with Zensical's structure in `docs/`.

## Core Documentation

- [README](README.md): Project overview, build instructions, and local development
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): Repository conventions, git workflow, commit policy, and content guidelines
- [Contributing Guide](docs/admin/README.md): Notes on content management (if present)
- [Disclaimer](docs/disclaimer.md): Important usage disclaimers

## Blog Categories

- [AI](docs/AI/index.md): AI tools, agents, LLMs, and agent workflows
- [AI/Agent-Work](docs/AI/Agent-Work/): Field notes on agent instructions, memory, commits, and maintaining agent lists
- [AI/OpenCode](docs/AI/OpenCode/): OpenCode guides, tutorials, and integrations
- [AI/Hermes](docs/AI/Hermes/): Hermes agent guides and integrations
- [AI/LLMs](docs/AI/LLMs/): LLM guides and resources
- [JS-TS](docs/JS-TS/index.md): JavaScript/TypeScript tooling and notes
- [Linux](docs/Linux/index.md): Linux guides and setup notes

## Key Articles

- [When an AI Agent Signs Your Commits](docs/AI/Agent-Work/when-an-ai-signs-your-commits.md): Removing non-consensual AI attribution from git history
- [What Keeps an Awesome List Honest](docs/AI/Agent-Work/agent-maintained-awesome-list.md): Governance, validation, and freshness for curated lists
- [When the Instructions Keep Repeating](docs/AI/Agent-Work/when-the-instructions-keep-repeating.md): Turning repeated agent instructions into system rules
- [Agent Instruction Drift](docs/AI/Agent-Work/agent-instruction-drift.md): Managing drift in agent instructions
- [Where an Agent's Memory Actually Lives](docs/AI/Agent-Work/agent-memory-surfaces.md): Understanding agent memory surfaces
